library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)

# Helper: Compute exact quantiles for standardized symmetric bimodal normal mixture
# E[Z] = 0, Var(Z) = mu^2 + tau^2 = 1
get_bimodal_quantiles <- function(probs = c(0.025, 0.975), mu = 0.88) {
  tau <- sqrt(1 - mu^2)
  sapply(probs, function(p) {
    uniroot(
      function(z) 0.5 * pnorm(z, -mu, tau) + 0.5 * pnorm(z, mu, tau) - p,
      interval = c(-10, 10)
    )$root
  })
}

ui <- fluidPage(
  tags$head(
    tags$style(HTML("
      body { background-color: #f8fafc; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; }
      .well { background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); }
      .metric-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(175px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
      .metric-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.03); }
      .metric-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; color: #64748b; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
      .metric-value { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; margin-top: 2px; }
      .metric-sub { font-size: 11px; color: #475569; margin-top: 2px; }
      .btn-toggle-active { background-color: #1e40af !important; color: #ffffff !important; border-color: #1e3a8a !important; }
      .plot-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
      .toolbar-right { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
      .section-header { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; color: #334155; margin-top: 12px; margin-bottom: 8px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
    "))
  ),
  
  titlePanel(
    div(
      style = "display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between;",
      h3("Regression Error Assumptions Explorer", style = "margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;"),
      span("Standard Assumption: ", HTML("ε ∼ N(0, σ<sup>2</sup>)"), style = "font-size: 15px; color: #475569;")
    )
  ),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      width = 3,
      div(class = "section-header", "1. Data Generating Process"),
      selectInput(
        "reg_fn", "True Regression Function f(X):",
        choices = c(
          "Linear" = "linear",
          "Quadratic" = "quadratic",
          "Exponential" = "exponential",
          "Sine Wave" = "sine"
        ),
        selected = "linear"
      ),
      selectInput(
        "err_dist", "Error Distribution:",
        choices = c(
          "Normal" = "normal",
          "Right-Skewed (Shifted Gamma)" = "skew_right",
          "Left-Skewed (Negated Gamma)" = "skew_left",
          "Heavy-Tailed (t, df = 3)" = "heavy_t",
          "Light-Tailed (Uniform)" = "uniform",
          "Bimodal (Symmetric Mixture)" = "bimodal"
        ),
        selected = "normal"
      ),
      selectInput(
        "err_rel", "Error Variance Relationship:",
        choices = c(
          "Constant (Homoscedastic)" = "constant",
          "Fanning Out (Increases with X)" = "fan_out",
          "Fanning In (Decreases with X)" = "fan_in",
          "Bowtie (Tight Middle, Wide Ends)" = "bowtie",
          "Parabola (Wide Middle, Tight Ends)" = "parabola"
        ),
        selected = "constant"
      ),
      sliderInput("n_obs", "Sample Size (n):", min = 100, max = 5000, value = 1000, step = 100),
      sliderInput("sigma", "Base Error SD (sigma):", min = 0.5, max = 5.0, value = 1.5, step = 0.25),
      actionButton(
        "resample", "Draw Fresh Random Sample",
        icon = icon("sync"),
        class = "btn-primary",
        style = "width: 100%; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 14px;"
      ),
      
      hr(),
      div(class = "section-header", "2. Scatterplot Overlays"),
      checkboxInput("show_ols", "Show OLS Regression Line", value = F),
      checkboxInput("show_pi", "Show OLS 95% Prediction Interval & Highlight Out-of-Bounds", value = F),
      checkboxInput("show_true", "Show True f(X) & True 95% Population Quantiles", value = FALSE),
      
      hr(),
      helpText(
        "Tip: Click and drag horizontally across the main scatterplot to create an X-window. ",
        "The green bracket inside the window shows the raw 2.5th to 97.5th percentiles of sampled Y."
      )
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      width = 9,
      # Top toolbar with diagnostic buttons on the right
      div(
        class = "toolbar-right",
        div(
          style = "font-size: 13px; color: #475569; font-weight: 500;",
          icon("hand-pointer"),
          " Drag horizontally on the scatterplot to inspect local coverage and empirical 95% intervals."
        ),
        div(
          style = "display: flex; gap: 8px;",
          actionButton("toggle_resid", "Residuals vs. X Plot", icon = icon("chart-scatter")),
          actionButton("toggle_qq", "Normal Q-Q & Residual Histogram", icon = icon("chart-line"))
        )
      ),
      
      # Live coverage & window metrics
      uiOutput("metrics_ui"),
      
      # Main Scatterplot
      div(
        class = "plot-card",
        plotOutput(
          "scatter_plot",
          height = "430px",
          brush = brushOpts(
            id = "x_brush",
            direction = "x",
            fill = "#3b82f6",
            stroke = "#1d4ed8",
            opacity = 0.16
          )
        )
      ),
      
      # Side-by-side Diagnostic Plots below
      uiOutput("diagnostics_ui")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Toggle states for diagnostic plots
  show_resid_plot <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
  show_qq_plot <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
  
  observeEvent(input$toggle_resid, {
    show_resid_plot(!show_resid_plot())
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$toggle_qq, {
    show_qq_plot(!show_qq_plot())
  })
  
  observeEvent(
    list(input$reg_fn, input$err_dist, input$err_rel, input$n_obs, input$sigma, input$resample),
    {
      updateCheckboxInput(session, "show_ols", value = FALSE)
      updateCheckboxInput(session, "show_pi", value = FALSE)
      updateCheckboxInput(session, "show_true", value = FALSE)
      session$resetBrush("x_brush")
    },
    ignoreInit = TRUE
  )
  
  # Compute true regression function f(x)
  eval_f <- function(x, type) {
    switch(type,
           "linear"      = 2 + 1.2 * x,
           "quadratic"   = 1 + 2.8 * x - 0.26 * x^2,
           "exponential" = 1.2 * exp(0.22 * x),
           "sine"        = 6 + 3.5 * sin(x)
    )
  }
  
  # Compute error scale multiplier s(x)
  eval_scale <- function(x, type) {
    switch(type,
           "constant" = rep(1.0, length(x)),
           "fan_out"  = 0.2 + 0.18 * x,
           "fan_in"   = 2.0 - 0.18 * x,
           "bowtie"   = 0.25 + 0.35 * abs(x - 5),
           "parabola" = 0.25 + 0.07 * (25 - (x - 5)^2)
    )
  }
  
  # Generate standardized error z (Mean = 0, SD = 1) and theoretical 2.5% / 97.5% quantiles
  generate_errors <- function(n, dist_type) {
    k_gamma <- 1.5
    mu_bi <- 0.88
    tau_bi <- sqrt(1 - mu_bi^2)
    
    switch(dist_type,
           "normal" = list(
             z = rnorm(n, 0, 1),
             q = qnorm(c(0.025, 0.975))
           ),
           "skew_right" = list(
             z = (rgamma(n, shape = k_gamma, rate = 1) - k_gamma) / sqrt(k_gamma),
             q = (qgamma(c(0.025, 0.975), shape = k_gamma, rate = 1) - k_gamma) / sqrt(k_gamma)
           ),
           "skew_left" = list(
             z = -(rgamma(n, shape = k_gamma, rate = 1) - k_gamma) / sqrt(k_gamma),
             q = -(qgamma(c(0.975, 0.025), shape = k_gamma, rate = 1) - k_gamma) / sqrt(k_gamma)
           ),
           "heavy_t" = list(
             z = rt(n, df = 3) / sqrt(3),
             q = qt(c(0.025, 0.975), df = 3) / sqrt(3)
           ),
           "uniform" = list(
             z = runif(n, -sqrt(3), sqrt(3)),
             q = qunif(c(0.025, 0.975), -sqrt(3), sqrt(3))
           ),
           "bimodal" = {
             signs <- sample(c(-1, 1), n, replace = TRUE)
             list(
               z = rnorm(n, mean = signs * mu_bi, sd = tau_bi),
               q = get_bimodal_quantiles(c(0.025, 0.975), mu = mu_bi)
             )
           }
    )
  }
  
  # Reactive dataset & OLS fit
  sim_data <- reactive({
    input$resample # Dependency on resample button
    
    n <- input$n_obs
    x <- sort(runif(n, min = 0, max = 10))
    fx <- eval_f(x, input$reg_fn)
    sx <- input$sigma * eval_scale(x, input$err_rel)
    err <- generate_errors(n, input$err_dist)
    
    y <- fx + sx * err$z
    df <- data.frame(x = x, y = y, fx = fx, sx = sx)
    
    # Fit OLS simple linear regression
    fit <- lm(y ~ x, data = df)
    pred_pi <- suppressWarnings(
      predict(fit, newdata = df, interval = "prediction", level = 0.95)
    )
    
    df$fitted <- pred_pi[, "fit"]
    df$pi_lwr <- pred_pi[, "lwr"]
    df$pi_upr <- pred_pi[, "upr"]
    df$resid  <- residuals(fit)
    df$in_pi  <- df$y >= df$pi_lwr & df$y <= df$pi_upr
    
    # True conditional 95% population quantiles
    df$true_lwr <- df$fx + df$sx * err$q[1]
    df$true_upr <- df$fx + df$sx * err$q[2]
    
    list(df = df, fit = fit)
  })
  
  # Reactive brushed window statistics
  window_stats <- reactive({
    df <- sim_data()$df
    b <- input$x_brush
    if (is.null(b)) return(NULL)
    
    sub_df <- df[df$x >= b$xmin & df$x <= b$xmax, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(sub_df) < 5) {
      return(list(valid = FALSE, n = nrow(sub_df), xmin = b$xmin, xmax = b$xmax))
    }
    
    emp_q <- quantile(sub_df$y, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), names = FALSE)
    ols_width <- mean(sub_df$pi_upr - sub_df$pi_lwr)
    emp_width <- emp_q[2] - emp_q[1]
    local_cov <- mean(sub_df$in_pi) * 100
    
    list(
      valid     = TRUE,
      xmin      = b$xmin,
      xmax      = b$xmax,
      xmid      = 0.5 * (b$xmin + b$xmax),
      n         = nrow(sub_df),
      emp_lwr   = emp_q[1],
      emp_upr   = emp_q[2],
      emp_width = emp_width,
      ols_width = ols_width,
      local_cov = local_cov
    )
  })
  
  # Render live summary metrics
  output$metrics_ui <- renderUI({
    df <- sim_data()$df
    ws <- window_stats()
    
    global_cov <- mean(df$in_pi) * 100
    global_width <- mean(df$pi_upr - df$pi_lwr)
    
    if (is.null(ws)) {
      win_cov_val   <- "Select X-Window"
      win_cov_sub   <- "Drag across plot to inspect slice"
      win_width_val <- "—"
      win_width_sub <- "Empirical vs. OLS 95% Width"
      emp_bounds_val <- "—"
      emp_bounds_sub <- "2.5th to 97.5th percentile of Y"
    } else if (!ws$valid) {
      win_cov_val   <- "Too Few Points"
      win_cov_sub   <- sprintf("n = %d in [%.2f, %.2f] (need >= 5)", ws$n, ws$xmin, ws$xmax)
      win_width_val <- "—"
      win_width_sub <- "Widen brush or increase n"
      emp_bounds_val <- "—"
      emp_bounds_sub <- "Widen brush or increase n"
    } else {
      win_cov_val   <- sprintf("%.1f%%", ws$local_cov)
      win_cov_sub   <- sprintf("X in [%.2f, %.2f] (n = %d)", ws$xmin, ws$xmax, ws$n)
      win_width_val <- sprintf("%.2f vs %.2f", ws$emp_width, ws$ols_width)
      win_width_sub <- "Empirical Width vs. OLS PI Width"
      emp_bounds_val <- sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", ws$emp_lwr, ws$emp_upr)
      emp_bounds_sub <- "Sampled Y (2.5% to 97.5%)"
    }
    
    div(
      class = "metric-grid",
      div(
        class = "metric-card",
        div(class = "metric-label", "Global OLS 95% PI Coverage"),
        div(class = "metric-value", sprintf("%.1f%%", global_cov)),
        div(class = "metric-sub", sprintf("Nominal target: 95.0%% (Mean Width: %.2f)", global_width))
      ),
      div(
        class = "metric-card",
        div(class = "metric-label", "Window OLS 95% PI Coverage"),
        div(class = "metric-value", style = if (!is.null(ws) && ws$valid && abs(ws$local_cov - 95) > 5) "color: #dc2626;" else "color: #0f172a;", win_cov_val),
        div(class = "metric-sub", win_cov_sub)
      ),
      div(
        class = "metric-card",
        div(class = "metric-label", "Window Width Comparison"),
        div(class = "metric-value", win_width_val),
        div(class = "metric-sub", win_width_sub)
      ),
      div(
        class = "metric-card",
        div(class = "metric-label", "Empirical 95% Interval (Slice Y)"),
        div(class = "metric-value", style = "color: #059669;", emp_bounds_val),
        div(class = "metric-sub", emp_bounds_sub)
      )
    )
  })
  
  # Main Scatterplot
  output$scatter_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- sim_data()$df
    ws <- window_stats()
    
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15)
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Observed Sample & Regression Intervals",
        x = "Predictor (X)",
        y = "Response (Y)"
      )
    
    # 1. OLS 95% Prediction Interval Ribbon
    if (input$show_pi) {
      p <- p +
        geom_ribbon(
          aes(ymin = pi_lwr, ymax = pi_upr),
          fill = "#93c5fd", alpha = 0.22
        ) +
        geom_line(aes(y = pi_lwr, color = "OLS 95% Prediction Interval"), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
        geom_line(aes(y = pi_upr, color = "OLS 95% Prediction Interval"), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8)
    }
    
    # 2. Scatterplot points (colored by PI inclusion if PI is toggled on)
    if (input$show_pi) {
      df$status <- ifelse(df$in_pi, "Inside OLS 95% PI", "Outside OLS 95% PI")
      p <- p + geom_point(
        data = df,
        aes(x = x, y = y, fill = status),
        shape = 21, color = "white", stroke = 0.2, size = 2.3, alpha = 0.8
      ) +
        scale_fill_manual(
          values = c("Inside OLS 95% PI" = "#475569", "Outside OLS 95% PI" = "#ef4444")
        )
    } else {
      p <- p + geom_point(color = "#475569", size = 2.1, alpha = 0.75)
    }
    
    # 3. True Regression Function & Population 95% Quantiles
    if (input$show_true) {
      p <- p +
        geom_line(aes(y = fx, color = "True E[Y|X] & 95% Pop. Quantiles"), linewidth = 1.1) +
        geom_line(aes(y = true_lwr, color = "True E[Y|X] & 95% Pop. Quantiles"), linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.9) +
        geom_line(aes(y = true_upr, color = "True E[Y|X] & 95% Pop. Quantiles"), linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.9)
    }
    
    # 4. OLS Regression Line
    if (input$show_ols) {
      p <- p + geom_line(aes(y = fitted, color = "OLS Fitted Line"), linewidth = 1.2)
    }
    
    # 5. Empirical 95% Interval of sampled Y inside brushed X-window
    if (!is.null(ws) && ws$valid) {
      emp_df <- data.frame(
        xmin = ws$xmin,
        xmax = ws$xmax,
        xmid = ws$xmid,
        lwr  = ws$emp_lwr,
        upr  = ws$emp_upr
      )
      p <- p +
        geom_rect(
          data = emp_df,
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
          fill = "#10b981", alpha = 0.18, color = "#059669", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.9
        ) +
        geom_errorbar(
          data = emp_df,
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          aes(x = xmid, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, color = "Empirical 95% Y Interval (Window)"),
          width = (ws$xmax - ws$xmin) * 0.45,
          linewidth = 1.3
        )
    }
    
    has_color_layer <- input$show_pi || input$show_true || input$show_ols || (!is.null(ws) && ws$valid)
    
    if (has_color_layer) {
      p <- p + scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "OLS Fitted Line"                   = "#1d4ed8",
          "OLS 95% Prediction Interval"       = "#2563eb",
          "True E[Y|X] & 95% Pop. Quantiles"  = "#d97706",
          "Empirical 95% Y Interval (Window)" = "#059669"
        )
      )
    }
    
    p
  })
  
  # Render side-by-side diagnostic plots below when toggled
  output$diagnostics_ui <- renderUI({
    show_r <- show_resid_plot()
    show_q <- show_qq_plot()
    
    if (!show_r && !show_q) return(NULL)
    
    if (show_r && show_q) {
      fluidRow(
        column(6, div(class = "plot-card", plotOutput("resid_plot", height = "320px"))),
        column(6, div(class = "plot-card", plotOutput("qq_hist_plot", height = "320px")))
      )
    } else if (show_r) {
      fluidRow(
        column(12, div(class = "plot-card", plotOutput("resid_plot", height = "320px")))
      )
    } else {
      fluidRow(
        column(12, div(class = "plot-card", plotOutput("qq_hist_plot", height = "320px")))
      )
    }
  })
  
  # Diagnostic 1: Residuals vs. X Plot
  output$resid_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- sim_data()$df
    ws <- window_stats()
    
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = resid)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#dc2626", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9) +
      geom_point(color = "#334155", alpha = 0.65, size = 1.9) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Residuals vs. X",
        subtitle = "Check linearity (centered at 0) and constant vertical spread across X",
        x = "Predictor (X)",
        y = "OLS Residual (e = Y - Y_hat)"
      )
    
    # Highlight brushed X-window on the residual plot as well
    if (!is.null(ws)) {
      p <- p + annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = ws$xmin, xmax = ws$xmax,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = "#3b82f6", alpha = 0.15
      )
    }
    
    p
  })
  
  # Diagnostic 2: Normal Q-Q Plot + Marginal Residual Histogram (Side-by-Side via base layout or cowplot-free grid)
  output$qq_hist_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- sim_data()$df
    res <- df$resid
    
    op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4.2, 4.2, 3.2, 1.2), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
    on.exit(par(op))
    
    # Left: Normal Q-Q Plot
    qqnorm(
      res,
      main = "Normal Q-Q Plot of Residuals",
      xlab = "Theoretical Normal Quantiles",
      ylab = "Sample Residual Quantiles",
      pch = 19,
      col = rgb(0.2, 0.25, 0.33, 0.55),
      cex = 0.85,
      bty = "l"
    )
    qqline(res, col = "#dc2626", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
    grid(col = "#e2e8f0", lty = "solid")
    
    # Right: Residual Histogram with Normal Density Overlay
    hist(
      res,
      breaks = 30,
      freq = FALSE,
      main = "Residual Distribution",
      xlab = "OLS Residual",
      ylab = "Density",
      col = "#cbd5e1",
      border = "white"
    )
    x_seq <- seq(min(res), max(res), length.out = 200)
    lines(x_seq, dnorm(x_seq, mean = mean(res), sd = sd(res)), col = "#dc2626", lwd = 2)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
